method.samples: stage-cycle uniform; no artificial wrap step
method.scope: all configured partners plus all interaction override displacement

handshake_offer.source_text: A standing person reaches the right hand forward at waist height, gives a firm handshake with two small up and down movements, then releases and lowers the hand. Feet planted.

handshake_reply.source_text: A standing person extends the right hand forward at waist height to meet another person in front, performs two gentle up and down handshake movements, then lowers the hand. Feet planted.

breakfast_sell.source_text: A street vendor standing behind a counter prepares food with both hands at waist height and extends the right hand forward to offer a breakfast bag. Feet planted.

breakfast_buy.source_text: A standing customer reaches to a breakfast counter to pay and receive a food bag, right hand at counter height, then draws it toward the chest. Feet planted.

interview_question.source_text: A standing street reporter holds a microphone steadily forward in the right hand at upper chest height, asking a question. The left hand makes a small open explanatory gesture. Feet stay planted, facing forward.

interview_answer.source_text: A standing person answers a reporter in front, speaks with small head nods, arms relaxed near the waist, feet planted. Calm conversational body language.

interview_listen.source_text: A standing street reporter holds a microphone steadily forward in the right hand at chest height, patiently listens and nods. Left arm relaxed down. Feet planted, facing forward.

interview_describe.source_text: A standing person describes an event to a reporter in front, both hands gesture widely at chest level, palms open, illustrating size and direction while speaking. Feet stay planted.

interview_followup.source_text: A standing street reporter extends the right hand holding a microphone toward another person in front. The left hand briefly points sideways then relaxes while asking a follow up question. Feet planted.

interview_point.source_text: A standing person speaking to a reporter points decisively to the right side with the left arm, holds the gesture, then turns back to the listener. Feet planted.

give_item.source_text: A person standing still offers a small object to someone in front of them. The right hand lifts from the waist and extends forward at waist height, pauses with the palm facing upward to offer the object, then returns to their side. The left arm stays relaxed.

receive_item.source_text: A person standing still reaches their right hand forward at waist height to accept a small object from someone in front. They pause with the hand extended, then bend the elbow and draw the right hand back toward their abdomen, holding the received object close. The left arm stays relaxed and the feet stay planted.

assist_elder_walk.source_text: An upright adult walks very slowly forward, supporting an elderly companion on the right. Right hand gently grips the companions left forearm at waist level, left arm naturally relaxed. Careful short synchronized steps.

elder_assisted_walk.source_text: An elderly person walks slowly forward with short careful shuffling steps and a stooped back. Their left forearm is held steadily at waist height toward a helper on the left. The right arm hangs relaxed.

table_tennis_play.source_text: A table tennis player in a ready crouch, feet shoulder width apart, holds a paddle in the right hand. Rotate the torso slightly right, swing the right forearm forward across the waist for a controlled forehand, then return to ready. Repeat twice. Small practical movement, no exaggerated waving.

table_tennis_partner.source_text: A table tennis player in a ready crouch, feet shoulder width apart, holds a paddle in the right hand. Rotate the torso slightly right, swing the right forearm forward across the waist for a controlled forehand, then return to ready. Repeat twice. Small practical movement, no exaggerated waving.

distribute_flyer.source_text: Standing holding a stack of leaflets in the left hand at waist height, pick one leaflet with the right hand, extend it politely forward at waist height to another person, let it go, retract the empty right hand to the stack.

receive_flyer.source_text: A person standing still reaches their right hand forward at waist height to accept a small object from someone in front. They pause with the hand extended, then bend the elbow and draw the right hand back toward their abdomen, holding the received object close. The left arm stays relaxed and the feet stay planted.

seesaw_seated.source_text: Sitting astride a seesaw seat, facing inward, both hands hold a short vertical handle between the thighs. Knees bent and apart, feet near the ground. Gently rise and lower twice with the seesaw, torso upright.

seesaw_partner.source_text: Sitting astride a seesaw seat, facing inward, both hands hold a short vertical handle between the thighs. Knees bent and apart, feet near the ground. Gently rise and lower twice with the seesaw, torso upright.

carry_box.source_text: A person stands balanced holding a box with both hands at the same height, elbows kept to the sides. Maintain the box grip with gentle breathing and small weight shifts, feet planted, no lifting or lowering.

walk_carry_box.source_text: A person walks forward while carefully carrying a small closed book horizontally in both hands at waist level in front of their stomach. Elbows bent, hands held close together and steady, regular careful steps.

hold_guitar.source_text: A standing musician holds an acoustic guitar across the front of the waist without playing. The left arm reaches diagonally left to hold the guitar neck at chest height, left elbow bent; the right forearm rests across the rounded guitar body in front of the abdomen. Hands stay apart and maintain the asymmetric guitar-holding pose. Small natural weight shift, no strumming.

carry_shoulder_bag.source_text: Walking straight forward while gripping a shoulder bag strap at the right collarbone with the right hand. Right elbow bent down by the body. Left arm swings naturally down by the left thigh. Keep right hand at the strap and keep walking.

pull_suitcase.source_text: A person walks forward steadily pulling a suitcase to the right side, right elbow bent and right hand held steady at waist height, left arm swinging naturally. Continuous walking, no stops.

walk_cane.source_text: A person walks forward with a cane in the right hand. The right leg is healthy and the left leg needs support. The cane and left foot advance together, then stay planted while the right leg steps through. Repeat this slow steady walking rhythm, keep holding the cane, no turning or stopping.

walk_closed_umbrella.source_text: A person strolls slowly forward with short relaxed alternating steps. Their hands stay together behind their lower back throughout, elbows bent, calm upright posture. They keep walking steadily without pausing.

photo_overhead.source_text: A person holds a smartphone in both hands high above their head to take a photograph over a crowd.

phone_call.source_text: A person stands talking on a phone held to their right ear.

phone_urgent.source_text: A person paces back and forth while talking urgently on the phone held at the right ear. Walk a few steps, turn around, walk back, then turn again. The right hand keeps the phone at the ear.

walk_phone_call.source_text: A person walks steadily forward while holding a mobile phone firmly against the right ear with the right hand, right elbow bent and raised. The left arm swings naturally. The phone hand stays beside the ear throughout.

drink.source_text: A person lifts a cup to their mouth with their right hand, takes a sip, and lowers the cup.

walk_drink.source_text: A person walks continuously forward carrying a drink cup in the right hand at chest height, raises the cup to the lips for one sip, then lowers it back to chest height while continuing to walk. The left arm swings naturally.

slouch_bench.source_text: A person stays slouched back on a bench, their torso reclined backward, legs stretched forward with heels resting on the floor, and arms hanging loosely at their sides. Their hips remain on the seat. They stay in this relaxed pose with only subtle breathing.

sit_sideways.source_text: A person sits sideways on a park bench, turning the hips and legs to the left while the torso turns gently back toward the front. The left arm rests along the top of the bench backrest behind the body, right hand on the thigh. Remain comfortably seated on a 45cm-high seat, feet on the ground.

push_cart.source_text: A person steadily walks straight forward pushing a shopping cart, with both hands continuously on the cart handle in front of the abdomen. Elbows relaxed and bent, forearms extending forward. Regular alternating walking steps, upright torso, maintain both grips, no turning or releasing.

push_stroller.source_text: A person steadily walks straight forward pushing a baby stroller, with both hands continuously on the stroller handle in front of the abdomen. Elbows relaxed and bent, forearms extending forward. Regular alternating walking steps, upright torso, maintain both grips, no turning or releasing.

walk_carry_bags.source_text: A person walks forward carrying a heavy grocery bag in each hand, both arms hanging straight down beside the thighs with the hands steady, no arm swinging, small balanced steps forward.

pullup_hold.source_text: A person maintains a bent arm hang from a horizontal pull up bar, feet suspended, torso upright, hands fixed to the bar. Gentle breathing and a small natural body sway.

pullup_raise.source_text: A person hanging from a high bar with both hands overhead pulls the body up by bending both elbows, raises chin above the bar, then slowly lowers back to straight arms, feet suspended.

sweep_ground.source_text: A person standing upright sweeps a small patch beside their right foot with a long broom. The upper left hand steadies the handle close to the chest, and the lower right hand holds it beside the right hip. The right elbow hangs down close to the waist. Gentle short sideways sweeping stroke and smooth return, with a relaxed subtle shift of weight. Keep the handle close to the body and the feet planted.

mop_ground.source_text: A cleaner mops the floor with a long upright mop held in both hands, pushes hands forward and draws them back in slow repeated strokes, bends slightly at hips, feet planted.

walk_backpack_straps.source_text: A person strides forward proudly with their chest lifted, chin raised and torso slightly leaning backward. Both arms swing broadly from the shoulders in time with confident long steps.

lean_railing.source_text: A person stands behind a waist-high railing, places both hands on the top bar and leans forward slightly to look beyond it. Both feet remain planted, elbows slightly bent, hips behind the rail. Keep both hands on the railing throughout.

chess_move.source_text: A seated person reaches the right hand forward to slide a chess piece a short distance on a table, then returns their hand to the lap. The hand moves down onto the board, pauses, then lifts away. Both feet stay planted and the hips remain on the chair.

take_back_piece.source_text: A person sits at a table 75cm high, reaches the right hand forward, picks up one chess piece from the near half of the board and brings the hand back toward the chest, reconsidering a move. Left hand on the thigh. Keep seated.

leg_stretch.source_text: A person faces a park bench, places the left heel onto the 45cm-high seat with the left leg almost straight, keeps the right foot planted on the ground, and leans the torso forward to stretch toward the raised leg. Hold the stretch without stepping or sitting.

press_button.source_text: A person stands facing a vending machine and reaches the right hand forward to press one button at chest height on the right side, pauses briefly at the button, then withdraws the hand to the side. Keep feet planted. One deliberate reach, press, and retract.

slap_table.source_text: A standing person leans forward and lifts the right hand then slaps the palm down once on a table 75cm high in front, emphatically in approval, then lifts the hand back off. Left arm relaxed. Keep the feet planted.

walk_newspaper_underarm.source_text: A person walks straight forward with their left hand kept inside their left trouser pocket throughout, while the right arm swings freely with each step. Casual steady steps, upright body.

eat_snack.source_text: A person eats a small snack, repeatedly bringing their right hand to their mouth and lowering it.

eat_walk.source_text: A person walks forward at a steady pace while eating a snack, keeping their right hand raised at their mouth the whole time. Their left arm swings naturally and their feet take regular alternating steps. They keep walking without stopping.

give_item.source_text: A person standing still offers a small object to someone in front of them. The right hand lifts from the waist and extends forward at waist height, pauses with the palm facing upward to offer the object, then returns to their side. The left arm stays relaxed.

receive_item.source_text: A person standing still reaches their right hand forward at waist height to accept a small object from someone in front. They pause with the hand extended, then bend the elbow and draw the right hand back toward their abdomen, holding the received object close. The left arm stays relaxed and the feet stay planted.

assist_elder_walk.source_text: An upright adult walks very slowly forward, supporting an elderly companion on the right. Right hand gently grips the companions left forearm at waist level, left arm naturally relaxed. Careful short synchronized steps.

turn_page.source_text: A standing person holds an open book in the left hand at chest height, looking down at the pages. The right hand reaches to the right edge of the book, lifts one page and sweeps it across from right to left, then rests again near the lower edge. The left hand stays steady supporting the book. One clear page-turning motion.

atm_take_cash.source_text: A standing person leans slightly forward, reaches the right hand into the cash slot of an ATM at waist height, withdraws banknotes and brings the hand back toward the abdomen.

vending_collect.source_text: A standing person bends at hips and knees to retrieve a bottle from a low vending machine hatch directly in front, right hand reaches down to knee height then lifts it, returns upright.

fountain_drink.source_text: A person standing at a drinking fountain bends deeply forward at the waist to sip water from a spout at one metre height, knees slightly bent, arms down, then stands back up.

post_letter.source_text: A standing person in front of a mailbox raises the right hand to chest height and slowly pushes a letter into a slot directly in front, then retracts the hand. Feet planted.

post_notice.source_text: A standing person faces a notice board, raises both hands forward to shoulder height, presses the upper corners of a paper notice flat against the board, smooths it with both hands, lowers arms.

buy_newspaper.source_text: A standing customer at a street newsstand reaches forward with the right hand at waist height, picks up a folded newspaper and brings it to the chest. Feet planted.

fruit_choose.source_text: A standing customer at a street newsstand reaches forward with the right hand at waist height, picks up a folded newspaper and brings it to the chest. Feet planted.

fruit_weigh.source_text: A standing fruit seller carefully moves both hands from one side of a waist high counter to the other, placing fruit onto a scale, looks down and waits.

breakfast_buy.source_text: A standing customer reaches to a breakfast counter to pay and receive a food bag, right hand at counter height, then draws it toward the chest. Feet planted.

breakfast_sell.source_text: A street vendor standing behind a counter prepares food with both hands at waist height and extends the right hand forward to offer a breakfast bag. Feet planted.

hang_laundry.source_text: A standing person raises both hands from chest height to above head height, reaches forward to hang a garment on a clothes rail, adjusts it with both hands and lowers arms. Feet planted.

water_planter_hold.source_text: A standing person holds a watering can steadily in the right hand in front, aiming its spout toward flowers. Small natural shifts, feet planted, left arm relaxed.

push_bicycle.source_text: A person walks forward with their right arm held straight down motionless alongside the body, while the left arm swings widely and naturally. Normal alternating steps, no object.

wallet_takeout.source_text: Standing casually, reach the right hand down to the right hip pocket, take out a wallet, bring it in front of the waist, open it with the left hand, then return it to the right pocket. Elbows relaxed close to the ribs.

phone_booth_call.source_text: Standing facing a payphone at chest height, reach the right hand forward to pick up the receiver, bring it to the right ear, listen with elbow pointing down, then replace the receiver forward at chest height.

cafe_sit_drink.source_text: Sitting on a chair at a cafe table, both feet resting on the floor, pick up a cup with the right hand, gently raise it to the mouth, sip while slightly tilting the wrist, lower it back to the table. Left hand rests on the thigh.

bike_scan_unlock.source_text: Standing beside a bicycle, hold a phone in the right hand at waist height, bend slightly forward to aim the phone at the bike handlebar, briefly hold steady to scan, straighten up and lower the phone.

basketball_dribble.source_text: A basketball player in a low balanced stance with bent knees dribbles a basketball repeatedly at the right side. Right palm pushes downward four times, wrist follows through. Left arm relaxed forward for balance. Feet stay shoulder width apart with small weight shifts.

basketball_shoot.source_text: A basketball player holding a ball at the chest bends knees, lifts the ball in front of the forehead, extends legs and arms upward into a set shot, flicks the right wrist, holds the follow-through, lowers arms and relaxes. No jump.

football_juggle.source_text: A football player standing balanced repeatedly taps a football upward with the right instep three times, keeping the ball low below knee height. Right knee raises and right foot flicks upward then lowers. Left leg supports body, arms out slightly for balance.

badminton_swing.source_text: A badminton player standing sideways in a balanced stance prepares an overhead forehand. Right elbow bends and racket hand goes behind the head, torso turns, right arm swings overhead forward to strike, follows through across the body, returns to ready. One controlled stroke.

table_tennis_play.source_text: A table tennis player in a ready crouch, feet shoulder width apart, holds a paddle in the right hand. Rotate the torso slightly right, swing the right forearm forward across the waist for a controlled forehand, then return to ready. Repeat twice. Small practical movement, no exaggerated waving.

distribute_flyer.source_text: Standing holding a stack of leaflets in the left hand at waist height, pick one leaflet with the right hand, extend it politely forward at waist height to another person, let it go, retract the empty right hand to the stack.

rummage_bin.source_text: Standing close to a waist high open bin, bend forward at the hips with slightly bent knees, support the left hand on its rim, reach the right hand down inside, slowly search side to side, withdraw the hand and straighten.

air_walker.source_text: Standing upright on an outdoor air walker exercise machine, both hands hold a horizontal bar at chest height. Legs alternately swing forward and backward like pendulums, knees slightly bent, torso remains steady. Two slow cycles.

swing_seated.source_text: Seated on a playground swing, hands grasp both suspension ropes beside the shoulders. Gently swing forward and back twice, extend lower legs on the forward swing and tuck feet back on the return. Relaxed upright torso.

seesaw_seated.source_text: Sitting astride a seesaw seat, facing inward, both hands hold a short vertical handle between the thighs. Knees bent and apart, feet near the ground. Gently rise and lower twice with the seesaw, torso upright.

slide_seated.source_text: Sitting at the top of a slide facing forward, legs together extended in front, palms resting beside the hips. Push off with the hands, slide forward while seated with torso upright and feet forward, then place feet on the ground and stand up.

car_enter.source_text: Standing next to the driver door of a car, use the left hand to pull the door open. Turn sideways, bend knees and duck the head, move hips sideways into the low driver seat first, then lift the outside leg over the sill and bring both feet forward into the footwell. Finish seated upright.

car_exit.source_text: Sitting in a low car driver seat, open the door with the left hand. Turn the body sideways, place the left foot outside on the ground, bring the right leg out, lean forward and stand up beside the car. Finish upright with both feet on the ground.

carry_shoulder.source_text: A person stands carrying a long heavy rolled carpet resting across the right shoulder. The right elbow is bent and lifted sideways, the right hand is beside the right temple steadying the load above the shoulder. The left arm hangs down. Torso leans slightly left to balance. Maintain this carrying pose throughout without walking.

seesaw_partner.source_text: Sitting astride a seesaw seat, facing inward, both hands hold a short vertical handle between the thighs. Knees bent and apart, feet near the ground. Gently rise and lower twice with the seesaw, torso upright.

hold_door.source_text: A person stands beside an already-open door and holds it steady with the right hand extended sideways, then turns the head and torso slightly left to let someone pass. Keep right hand on the door and feet planted.

push_door.source_text: A person approaches a closed door, reaches for the right-side handle with the right hand, pushes the left-hinged door away until fully open, releases the handle and walks forward through the doorway. Keep the left arm relaxed close to the body. One continuous natural opening and entry, no turning back.

pull_door.source_text: A person faces a door. They approach it and grasp the handle with the LEFT hand. Pull the door toward themselves while taking small steps backward and sideways. Keep the left hand holding the handle while opening it, then release. Smoothly walk around the end of the open door in a continuous curved arc, turn to face forward, and walk normally forward through the doorway. Unhurried natural walking with clearly alternating footfalls. No rushing or running. Continue walking forward at the end.

parcel_terminal.source_text: A standing person taps a parcel locker touchscreen at chest height with the right hand several times, then lowers the hand, feet planted.

throw_trash.source_text: A person stands in front of a waist-high litter bin, leans forward slightly and reaches the right hand toward the front opening to toss an empty paper coffee cup inside, then draws the right hand back. Left hand stays by the side. Keep feet planted.

browse_bookstall.source_text: A standing person bends slightly forward over a waist high book stall, both hands open a book on the table, right hand turns a few pages while left hand holds it flat, looks down.

pat_dust.source_text: A person pats dust off the front of their trousers with both hands.

look_up.source_text: A person tilts their head back to look up at the sky while standing still.

table_tennis_partner.source_text: A table tennis player in a ready crouch, feet shoulder width apart, holds a paddle in the right hand. Rotate the torso slightly right, swing the right forearm forward across the waist for a controlled forehand, then return to ready. Repeat twice. Small practical movement, no exaggerated waving.

receive_flyer.source_text: A person standing still reaches their right hand forward at waist height to accept a small object from someone in front. They pause with the hand extended, then bend the elbow and draw the right hand back toward their abdomen, holding the received object close. The left arm stays relaxed and the feet stay planted.

read_book.source_text: A person stands holding an open book in both hands at lower chest height and reads it quietly. The hands support the two lower corners of the book about thirty centimeters apart, elbows bent down by the ribs. Tilt the head down to look at the pages. Keep holding the open book steadily with small natural weight shifts.

take_photo.source_text: A standing person steadily holds a camera with both hands just below eye level, looks at the camera viewfinder and takes a photograph. Slight breathing, feet planted, body upright.

lean_sign.source_text: A person stands with the left shoulder lightly resting against a bus-stop pole, weight mostly on the left leg and right knee relaxed, arms down. Remain stationary beside the pole.

waist_twister.source_text: A person stands on a park waist twisting exercise disc, feet together, both hands holding a bar in front at waist height, twists hips and feet left and right while shoulders face forward.

hands_on_head.source_text: A standing person reacts in dismay by raising both arms out to the sides and placing both palms firmly on the top and back of their head. Fingers rest on the crown, wrists above the ears, elbows spread widely sideways at shoulder height. The face remains completely uncovered. The person bows their head slightly while holding the crown with both hands, elbows staying wide. Hold this hands-on-top-of-head pose, then lower both arms back to the sides.
